title: Practice: Adjectives and possessives, plural; surnames

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Он отмахнулся от ___ (мой, gen. pl.) возражений.
exercises.why: **мой → моих** (gen. pl., agreeing with возражений). A possessive — declines like DLI's мой. Ending -и → -их.  Declension of мой (plural): мои · моих · моим · мои (inan.) / моих (anim.) · моими · моих.  «Notice the similarity of the endings of the possessives to the form of «они».» мой · моё — моего — моему — моим — о моём; моя — моей — мою; мои — моих — моим — моими — о моих. — DLI, Lessons 47–48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Он не согласен с ___ (новый, instr. pl.) реформами.
exercises.prompt: He doesn't agree with the new reforms.
exercises.why: **новый → новыми** (instr. pl., agreeing with реформами). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): I. новыми. Ending -ые → -ыми.  Declension of новый (plural): новые · новых · новым · новые (inan.) / новых (anim.) · новыми · новых.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том любит разглагольствовать на ___ (злободневный, acc. pl.) темы.
exercises.prompt: Tom loves soapboxing about the hot button issue of the day.
exercises.why: **злободневный → злободневные** (acc. pl., agreeing with темы). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension of злободневный (plural): злободневные · злободневных · злободневным · злободневные (inan.) / злободневных (anim.) · злободневными · злободневных.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.prompt: Don't pay any attention to her whims.
exercises.why: **её** (and «его», «их») is the same in every case and number: it does not agree with the noun it belongs to, unlike «мой», «наш». Only the noun changes with its case.

exercises.q: Том верит в ___ (паранормальный, acc. pl.) явления.
exercises.why: **паранормальный → паранормальные** (acc. pl., agreeing with явления). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension of паранормальный (plural): паранормальные · паранормальных · паранормальным · паранормальные (inan.) / паранормальных (anim.) · паранормальными · паранормальных.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Петушиные бои запрещены во ___ (многий, prep. pl.) странах.
exercises.prompt: Cockfighting is banned in many countries.
exercises.why: **многий → многих** (prep. pl., agreeing with странах). Adjective type III, guttural (after г, к, х) — declines like DLI's русский (every form has the same endings): P. русских. Ending -ие → -их.  Declension of многий (plural): многие · многих · многим · многие (inan.) / многих (anim.) · многими · многих.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: В ___ (девяностый, acc. pl.) годы Интернет называли ещё "информационным суперхайвеем".
exercises.prompt: The Internet was also called the information superhighway in the 1990s.
exercises.why: **девяностый → девяностые** (acc. pl., agreeing with годы). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension of девяностый (plural): девяностые · девяностых · девяностым · девяностые (inan.) / девяностых (anim.) · девяностыми · девяностых.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: К ___ (иной, dat. pl.) фразеологизмам не так-то просто подобрать годный перевод.
exercises.prompt: For some expressions, it's not so easy to find an appropriate translation.
exercises.why: **иной → иным** (dat. pl., agreeing with фразеологизмам). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings, apart from the masculine nominative singular (and the inanimate accusative equal to it), which ends in -ой here, not -ый): D. новым. Ending -ые → -ым.  Declension of иной (plural): иные · иных · иным · иные (inan.) / иных (anim.) · иными · иных.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.» «The adjective «большой» belongs to the guttural type, in spite of its -ш-: большого, большому, большим, о большом.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Пассажиры набиты в ___ (городской, acc. pl.) автобусы как сардины в банку.
exercises.prompt: Passengers are packed in like sardines on city buses.
exercises.why: **городской → городские** (acc. pl., agreeing with автобусы). Adjective type III, guttural (after г, к, х) — declines like DLI's русский (every form has the same endings, apart from the masculine nominative singular (and the inanimate accusative equal to it), which ends in -ой here, not -ий): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension of городской (plural): городские · городских · городским · городские (inan.) / городских (anim.) · городскими · городских.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.» «The adjective «большой» belongs to the guttural type, in spite of its -ш-: большого, большому, большим, о большом.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.prompt: Sharks are killed for their fins.
exercises.why: **их** (and «его», «их») is the same in every case and number: it does not agree with the noun it belongs to, unlike «мой», «наш». Only the noun changes with its case.

exercises.q: Пилоты поддерживают связь с ___ (аэропортовый, instr. pl.) службами по радио.
exercises.prompt: Pilots communicate with airport services by radio.
exercises.why: **аэропортовый → аэропортовыми** (instr. pl., agreeing with службами). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): I. новыми. Ending -ые → -ыми.  Declension of аэропортовый (plural): аэропортовые · аэропортовых · аэропортовым · аэропортовые (inan.) / аэропортовых (anim.) · аэропортовыми · аэропортовых.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Он действительно печётся о ___ (свой, prep. pl.) родителях.
exercises.prompt: He really cares for his parents.
exercises.why: **свой → своих** (prep. pl., agreeing with родителях). A possessive — declines like DLI's мой. Ending -и → -их.  Declension of свой (plural): свои · своих · своим · свои (inan.) / своих (anim.) · своими · своих.  «Notice the similarity of the endings of the possessives to the form of «они».» мой · моё — моего — моему — моим — о моём; моя — моей — мою; мои — моих — моим — моими — о моих. — DLI, Lessons 47–48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Земельная реформа привела к ___ (больший, dat. pl.) переменам в жизни людей.
exercises.prompt: Land reform caused a great change in the lives of the people.
exercises.why: **больший → большим** (dat. pl., agreeing with переменам). Adjective type IV, sibilant (after ж, ч, ш, щ) — declines like DLI's хороший (every form has the same endings): D. хорошим. Ending -ие → -им.  Declension of больший (plural): большие · больших · большим · большие (inan.) / больших (anim.) · большими · больших.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

**наш → наших** (prep. pl., agreeing with головах). A possessive — declines like DLI's наш. Ending -и → -их.
